project_title: Contract Fragility and Schema Complexity Benchmark: Stage C Controlled Synthetic Investigation
author: Rishindra Mateti
research_question: Under controlled synthetic task conditions, how do specified schema transformations affect structured tool-use task completion?

task_categories.name: Argument Construction
task_categories.description: Construct valid structured argument payload for a known target tool given natural language instruction.

task_categories.name: Tool Selection Among Distractors
task_categories.description: Identify and invoke the exact target tool from a catalog containing controlled distractors with domain and structural overlap.

task_categories.name: Abstention When No Valid Tool Applies
task_categories.description: Refuse invocation or emit formal abstention when instruction cannot be satisfied by any available candidate tool.

primary_metrics.name: Tool-Name Exact Match
primary_metrics.description: Selected tool name exactly matches gold target tool identifier.

primary_metrics.name: Syntax-Valid Argument Rate
primary_metrics.description: Emitted payload is valid JSON and satisfies structural Draft-07 validation against active schema.

primary_metrics.name: Semantic Argument Exact Match
primary_metrics.description: Decoded latent intent of emitted payload exactly matches gold latent intent values across all defined fields.

primary_metrics.name: Abstention Precision
primary_metrics.description: True abstentions divided by total predicted abstentions.

primary_metrics.name: Abstention Recall
primary_metrics.description: True abstentions divided by gold abstention instances.

secondary_metrics.name: Component-Level Precision
secondary_metrics.description: Proportion of emitted argument fields matching gold field values.

secondary_metrics.name: Component-Level Recall
secondary_metrics.description: Proportion of gold required and optional fields correctly populated.

secondary_metrics.name: Parse Failure Rate
secondary_metrics.description: Proportion of responses failing JSON parsing or structural tool-call extraction.

secondary_metrics.name: Malformed JSON Rate
secondary_metrics.description: Proportion of syntax failures resulting from formatting or truncation issues.

mutation_families.name: Canonical Baseline
mutation_families.description: Clean, normalized Draft-07 baseline representation serving as the experimental control.

mutation_families.name: Nested Hierarchy
mutation_families.description: Reorganizes schema properties into deterministic multi-level container objects with reversible latent mappings.

mutation_families.name: Optionality Bloat
mutation_families.description: Injects controlled optional parameters, default values, and nullable constraints to evaluate surface noise sensitivity.

mutation_families.name: Ambiguous Identifiers
mutation_families.description: Systematically transforms field names using deterministic semantic aliases and domain abbreviations.

mutation_families.name: Distractor-Set Complexity
mutation_families.description: Increases candidate catalog density and semantic proximity of distractor tools without modifying target contract semantics.

stop_gates.gate_0: Full offline test suite execution and verification
stop_gates.gate_1: Cryptographic reproducibility verification of contracts and task instances
stop_gates.gate_2: Adversarial audit of prompt templates and leakage prevention
stop_gates.gate_3: Formal human authorization required before executing LLM inference
